name: Battle's Spark

source.title: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide

text:
You saw the Pathfinder Society helping during the Hellfire Crisis and were filled with hope and purpose. You signed up on the spot and are now a full-fledged agent.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.
